package.name: roqsim_create3_toolbox
package.description: The iRobot Create 3 / TurtleBot 4 software stack over roqsim: the simulator adapter that turns what the TurtleBot 4 model publishes (bumper zones, cliff and IR ray grids, joint states, ground-truth poses) into what the Create 3's own nodes consume, plus the launch files that run those nodes unchanged from their released packages. Mirrors irobot_create_gz_bringup for the MuJoCo substrate; the stack itself (irobot_create_nodes, turtlebot4_node) is never reimplemented.
